tone.target: minimal clean guitar support, piano-led ballad
tone.profile: minimal clean guitar support, piano-led ballad
tone.summary: A highly clean signal chain using Comp for warmth, followed by a Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) with minimal EQ shaping, paired with a US 2x12 cabinet and gentle Room reverb.
corrections: Guitar is not prominent or defining
Draft invented modulation/delay not in recording

rig.name: Adele - Someone Like You - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum inherent in quiet ballad recordings.
Add warmth and sustain to the sparse arpeggios, making the guitar sound more present without being aggressive.
Keep the signal completely clean and transparent to match the pristine nature of the recording.
Provide the required Fender-style clean headroom and bright, articulate tone suitable for background accompaniment.
Match the bright and articulate sound profile of a Fender-style amp.
Slightly scoop the frequencies to ensure the guitar sits subtly in the mix without clashing with the dominant piano.
Avoid any modulation effects (Chorus, Tremolo) as per the musical verdict.
Avoid noticeable delay washes to maintain the intimate, dry feel of a ballad.
Provide subtle, natural room ambience to give the guitar depth without distracting from the main vocal/piano performance.
Subtly attenuate the overall signal to ensure it remains a background element and does not compete with the piano.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better match the intimate, dry sound of a ballad.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Acoustic/Small Room IR (e.g., small room mic'd acoustic guitar)
proposals.reason: The current US 2x12 is too bright and aggressive for a subtle background role.
